source: RFC 0014 R1 (mixed-version compatibility; the maintainer's direction of 2026-11-24, “按这个方向”, and the coordinator's decision of a 503 for an unknown must-understand member); the compatibility review of 2026-11-24 (CE-1, CE-5, §5.1)
statement: A reader of the CoSec-Identity header ignores a member it does not know, at any level (the root, `scope`, `memberships`, `auth`, `auth.session`), unless the header's `crit` names it; nothing walks an object's members to find the unknown ones. `crit`, at the root only, lists the paths from the root of members a reader must understand, member names of lower-case letters, digits and `_` joined by `.`; a path into a map whose keys are data (a claim, a space) names no member. A member it names that this version does not know refuses the header with 503 `unavailable` (IdentityFormatException UNSUPPORTED_MEMBER), before the rest of the header is read: a later version wrote it, and this one cannot decide as it meant; never 401, which a client takes as the end of its session. The refusal is counted as `cosec.identity.refused{problem=unavailable}`, and its log line names the member (escaped and bounded) and says this service is older than its writer counted on, apart from any store outage. A `crit` that is not one is malformed, 400 `invalid-request`: not an array, more than 16 entries, an entry that is not such a path or holds an unpaired surrogate, an entry repeated, or an entry this version knows that the header does not hold; an empty list is no list. The format version `v` is unchanged; a member of the wrong type, a duplicate, an invalid or blank id and a header over the size limit are refused as before. CoSec's 8.0 writers write no `crit`, since every 8.0 member is one every 8.x reader knows (IdentityMembers). A member a hop does not know is lost when that hop rewrites the header, which is what makes it ignorable; a member `crit` names stops the chain at the first hop that does not know it.
guards: document:IdentityCritTest#a member this version does not know is ignored at every level, and the identity reads as without it - IDN-41
document:IdentityCritTest#an unknown member must still be JSON, and a duplicate is refused - IDN-41
document:IdentityCritTest#crit naming members this version knows and the header holds reads as without it - IDN-41
document:IdentityCritTest#crit naming a member this version does not know refuses the header as a later version's - IDN-41
document:IdentityCritTest#a crit of more than sixteen entries is malformed - IDN-41
document:IdentityCritTest#a malformed entry is refused as malformed even beside an unknown one - IDN-41
document:IdentityCritTest#CoSec's writers write no crit - IDN-41
document:IdentityCodecMessageTest#members crit names and this version lacks are bounded, at most three named, and a forged entry is not quoted
runtime:IdentityMustUnderstandTest#a member the service does not know is ignored, and the caller is the one the header states - IDN-41
runtime:IdentityMustUnderstandTest#a member crit names that the service does not know is refused with 503, counted and logged apart - IDN-41
runtime:IdentityMustUnderstandTest#a malformed crit is refused with 400, as any malformed header - IDN-41
runtime:IdentityMustUnderstandTest#an ignorable member is lost at the next hop, and the host decides as without it - IDN-41
runtime:IdentityMustUnderstandTest#a must-understand member stops the chain at the first hop that does not know it - IDN-41
